The mark is the teacher's own and the student never reads it. A work with no revision yet is 409. Only a teacher of the work may; every other caller gets 404.

200.description: the revision now marked reviewed and when

delete.summary: Deletes the sealed note; the reading place stays. Deleting what is not there changes nothing. Answers what the owner keeps. Only the student who owns the work; to anyone else, the mentor and the teachers of the work included, and for an unknown or malformed work it is 404.

get.summary: The student's sealed note to self (MK-9) as it was written, byte for byte, and the reading place, null where none is kept. The server never sees the text, the place of the note, the phrase, the recovery code or the note key. Only the student who owns the work; to anyone else, the mentor and the teachers of the work included, and for an unknown or malformed work it is 404.

put.summary: Writes the sealed note, replacing the earlier one: {sealed: {v: 1, keyId, iv, ct}}, iv 12 and ct 1296 bytes in base64url. keyId must be the note key the owner keeps now (profile.self-note-key.get), else 409 and nothing is written. The server checks only the shape and the lengths; the rules of the text (1 to 280 characters) are the device's. The server never sees the text, the place of the note, the phrase, the recovery code or the note key. Only the student who owns the work; to anyone else, the mentor and the teachers of the work included, and for an unknown or malformed work it is 404.

get.summary: The caller's own items of the work that its student has opened, with the instant of the first opening, oldest first, at most 5000 (MK-11). An item not yet opened, gone or no longer visible has no entry; the student reads an empty list. The student of the work and the teachers of its assignment read; for anyone else and an unknown or malformed work it is 404.

200.description: the caller's items the student has seen

post.summary: A reader of the work reports the items it opened: {items: [{kind, id}]}, 1 to 200, kind comment (published), revision_request, milestone_revision or message. The first instant of opening stays; a later report changes nothing. An item that is not on the work, not visible to the caller or the caller's own is passed over. Answers every reported item that is kept, with its first instant. The student of the work and the teachers of its assignment report; for anyone else and an unknown or malformed work it is 404.

200.description: the reported items that are kept

delete.summary: Deletes the note to self; the reading place stays. Deleting what is not there changes nothing. Answers what the owner keeps. Only the student who owns the work; to anyone else, the mentor and the teachers of the work included, and for an unknown or malformed work it is 404.

get.summary: The student's note to self (MK-9) and reading place on a work, null where none is kept. Only the student who owns the work; to anyone else, the mentor and the teachers of the work included, and for an unknown or malformed work it is 404.

put.summary: Writes the note to self, replacing the earlier one: {text, place?}, text 1 to 280 characters with a non-space, NFC, no control character but newline and tab, no bidi control; place {nodeId, offset} or null. Answers what the owner keeps. Only the student who owns the work; to anyone else, the mentor and the teachers of the work included, and for an unknown or malformed work it is 404.

delete.summary: Deletes the private note selected by the noteId query parameter.

get.summary: Lists the student's private notes on one source of the document identified by the work id.

patch.summary: Updates supplied fields. Null clears a field. At least one text field must remain.

post.summary: Creates a private note with at least one text field. A source holds up to 100 notes.

get.summary: The committee of this thesis as the administrator named it: the members with their role (chair or member) and when the list was written. It is a list only and gives no access to the work. For the student owner, the mentor and the administrator of the faculty; anyone else, another faculty and a work that is not a mentored thesis read 404.

put.summary: The administrator of the faculty replaces the whole committee: at most 5 members, at most one chair, all different, each a teacher confirmed in the same faculty and not the student who writes the work (422 otherwise). The same list as the one in force writes nothing. Every change is kept as an event. The student and the mentor are 403.

Sets the state of one form of this work. The student owner moves between not_submitted and submitted and cannot touch an accepted form (403 for accepted, 409 on an accepted form); the mentor and the administrator set any state. The state in force writes nothing.

get.summary: The forms in force for the type of this thesis with the state of each (not_submitted, submitted, accepted), for the student owner, the mentor and the administrator of the faculty. A form whose state was set stays listed after it is retired.
The stage of this thesis after the submission: none, submitted_to_office (predano referadi), defense_scheduled (with its date) or defended.

put.summary: The mentor or the administrator of the faculty sets the stage; any stage may follow any other (a correction too). defense_scheduled needs defenseAt; none and submitted_to_office take none. The student owner is 403.

post.summary: The mentor approves the topic or returns it with a comment; the comment is required to return it. `version` must be the newest one (409 otherwise). A returned version takes no further decision (the student proposes again); an approved one can only be returned, with a reason. The student and the administrator are 403.

get.summary: The topic of this thesis as the student proposed it and the mentor decided: the state (none, proposed, approved, returned), the newest proposal, the decision on it and every proposal in order. For the student owner, the mentor and the administrator of the faculty; anyone else, another faculty and a work that is not a mentored thesis read 404.

put.summary: The student owner proposes the topic: a new version with the title (1 to 200 characters) and an optional description (up to 1000). The content of the newest version writes nothing. After approval it is 409, as is the 101st version. The mentor and the administrator are 403.

get.summary: Reads one verified revision of the work from its checkpoint. The owner can read saved revisions; the active mentor can read only versions sent for review or submitted. With compareFrom set to an earlier revision, returns the wave 9 block diff of two sent revisions. Missing or inaccessible work or revision returns 404.

200.description: a verified revision or the difference between two sent revisions

get.summary: One page of the versions of a work, newest first (revision descending, the submission before the checkpoint of its revision), at most 200: the saved points of the document up to the submitted revision and the submission. The same list for the owner and the teacher of the assignment; a teacher's read writes the access log. beforeRevision, from nextBeforeRevision of the previous page, asks for the versions below that revision; a revision is never split across two pages. Another's, an unknown or a malformed work returns 404.

200.description: one page of versions, possibly empty
